reason: User input flows through doSomething() (base64 roundtrip preserves content) to bar, which combines with TESTFILES_DIR to form fileName passed to FileOutputStream constructor. The XSS sink uses encodeForHTML which provides protection, but the path-injection sink (new File(fileName)) has no validation - user input can cause directory traversal or arbitrary file access. The double-base64 encoding does not prevent path traversal attacks.

evidence.note: user param flows to fileName via doSomething, combined with TESTFILES_DIR for FileOutputStream
